='''The King of Thieves'''=

Followers of Bristlebane believe in having fun at the expense of nearly all else. [[Bard|Bards]], [[Rogue|Rogues]], jesters, gamblers and gypsies are all typical followers. They are almost always very charming, clever and witty: traits all his followers should strive to possess. Mischief in all its forms is encouraged. Practical jokes are performed as if they were the highest rituals. Very few of his followers are outright wicked in their desires, but it is best to keep at least one eye on your purse if they are about. And never let one deal you a hand of King's Court.

==Followers of Bristlebane==
Bristlebane's home is the unique and enigmatic [[Plane of Mischief]], where he can occasionally be heard to shout from some secret location, and rumors swirl about where and when and how he may or may not make appearances. It is not entirely clear whether any of the [[Denizens of Mischief]] are there because they are his followers, or whether they simply act out various roles in some kind of play that they have been tricked into performing for his amusement.

Bristlebane is the creator of the race of [[Halfling]]s, which may be one of his bigger jokes (unless it is one of his smaller ones). Although he has Halfling priests, the [[Priests of Mischief]], he seems to prefer Rogues and Bards, and has followers among them from every race.

The only other group that follows Bristlebane is a small minority of the least trustworthy Gnomes. They do not take responsibility for running their own guild, but instead mooch off the Gnomish followers of Brell Serelis, becoming almost indistinguishable from them.
